caveats: formal is Python source; an English dependency parser applied to it produces labels that are consistent but not linguistically meaningful. Its syn_dissim is a real parse distance, not a claim about English syntax.
_meta.lex_dissim_method: normalized character Levenshtein distance, dist / max(len_a, len_b)
_meta.lex_dissim_robustness_method: token-type Jaccard distance, lowercased [A-Za-z0-9_]+ runs, numerals retained
_meta.syn_dissim_method: dependency-label bag total-variation distance from a spacy dependency parse
